name: Brontosaurus
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Proficiency bonus +3. Constitution saving throw +6. Passive Perception 10. No languages.
appearance: A heavy gray-green quadruped with an upright neck, columnar legs, and a long curved tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, first printing, October 2021, Chapter 2, Dinosaurs, stat block p. 95. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/2560746-brontosaurus
sections.Actions:
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 20 ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 27 (5d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. The target falls prone if it fails a DC 14 Strength saving throw.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, 20 ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 32 (6d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Encounter ecology: Its size discourages most predators. It uses its tail against smaller threats that come close.
sections.Source notes: Both attacks have a printed reach of 20 ft. Only Stomp can knock the target prone.

name: Deinonychus
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No languages.
appearance: An olive-green biped with a long stiff tail, hooked toe claws, and curled foreclaws.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, first printing, October 2021, Chapter 2, Dinosaurs, stat block p. 95. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/2560770-deinonychus
sections.Traits: Pounce. Move at least 20 ft. directly toward a creature, then hit it with Claw on that turn. It falls prone if it fails a DC 12 Strength saving throw. If it is prone, the deinonychus can use a bonus action to Bite it once.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5 ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5 ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Encounter ecology: A larger relative of the velociraptor that hooks prey with its claws and feeds while gripping it.
sections.Source notes: The bonus-action Bite keys off the target being prone after the Claw trigger. The printed text does not require that the Pounce save caused the prone condition.

name: Dimetrodon
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +2. Passive Perception 12. No languages.
appearance: A low, wide-jawed reptile with short legs, a tapering tail, and a tall burnt-orange sail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, first printing, October 2021, Chapter 2, Dinosaurs, stat block p. 95. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/2560776-dimetrodon
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5 ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 9 (2d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter ecology: This sail-backed reptile shares territory with dinosaurs and hunts along shores and in shallow water like a crocodile.
sections.Source notes: The creature account calls it a reptile. The stat block gives it the Dinosaur tag.

name: Velociraptor
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No languages.
appearance: A feathered, rust-and-cream biped with a narrow snout and long, nearly level tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, first printing, October 2021, Chapter 2, Dinosaurs, stat block p. 96, creature account p. 95. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/2560950-velociraptor
sections.Traits: Pack Tactics. The velociraptor rolls with advantage to attack a creature if it has an ally within 5 ft. of that creature and that ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5 ft. reach, one creature. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, 5 ft. reach, one target. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.
sections.Encounter ecology: About the size of a large turkey, this feathered predator often hunts in packs to take larger prey.
sections.Source notes: The creature account begins in the right column of p. 95. The full stat block is in the lower right column of p. 96.
